tk01npctool000001.invariant: THE NPC TOOLKIT (moonshot 2026-08-12): our k8s/k3s DeepSeek swarms are NPCs to PCs. Their toolbelt = SENSE + COMMUNICATE + ACT under fog of war. SENSE: swarm_sense (one compact health/capacity/economics/map snapshot — the eyes). COMMUNICATE: swarm_pheromone (stigmergy — content-addressed ant-trails that outlive the kill-and-respawned NPC) + swarm_blackboard (the egregore's shared mind — decisions/conflicts pinned forever, rest evict). ACT: memlance + scratchpad + verkle_write + route_novel (already real). Every tool quantizes via tool_quant (Merkle-root essence).

tk02egregore000002.invariant: THE BLACKBOARD IS THE EGREGORE'S MIND (steal from agentswarm): note kinds finding|decision|conflict|open-question|handoff|claim. DECISIONS + CONFLICTS are PINNED FOREVER (they anchor mission-wide coherence); everything else is evicted past a cap. An NPC reads the mind before acting and posts its decisions there. Never silently drop a decision/conflict.

tk03pheromone000003.invariant: PHEROMONE = STIGMERGY, the ant's way: coordinate WITHOUT a shared brain by leaving content-addressed, immutable marks (trail|fruitful|dead|here|danger|signal) that outlive the NPC. A stateless, respawned worker picks up its dead predecessor's trail. The trail is the memory the body doesn't carry — like the verkle chain outliving each worker.

tk04sense000000004.invariant: SENSE UNDER FOG OF WAR: an NPC perceives its OWN body locally, never the whole world. swarm_sense fuses health + capacity + economics + map into ONE bounded snapshot. HONEST — every field that's unavailable is reported as an error, never fabricated. One call replaces six separate monitors.

tk05seamclosed00005.invariant: THE SEAM IS CLOSED (2026-08-12): swarm_worker._tool_context() now INJECTS the carried tools' real state into the agent's query — swarm_sense field + pheromone trail + blackboard pinned decisions are read live and prepended, so a stateless builder ACTS under its own trails. The castle builds itself: each NPC drops a knot + pheromone, the next reads the trail and builds on it, no central brain. Lazy import avoids the swarm_tools<->swarm_worker circular dep.

tk06toolsusable0006.invariant: THE NPCs CAN USE THE TOOLS (2026-08-12, 'so they need to be able to use them right? steal'): passive injected context is NOT use. The 5 swarm tools (swarm_sense, pheromone_drop, pheromone_trail, blackboard_post, blackboard_read) are now REAL agent tools: registered in tools/__init__.py TOOL_MAP + _FN (dispatch resolves), declared in agent_cli TOOL_SCHEMAS (the model sees + calls them), and pheromone_drop/blackboard_post added to _MUTATING_TOOLS (the false-success guard counts their writes). tools/swarm_tools.py wraps mag.swarm_tools with clean signatures. A worker running main.py agent now calls these as tools during the build — the castle builds itself, for real.
